subject: Private deployment: localized pricing, SKU consolidation & phased support tranches
messages:
From: Sofia Rossi <sofia.rossi@cloudhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cloudhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Private deployment pricing inquiry — EUR quoting and SKU consolidation

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked the latency profiles and the dedicated node concept. Two quick asks from procurement and engineering as we prepare an internal ask: 1) Can Redwood provide a localized (EUR) commercial outline for a VPC/on‑prem deployment? Our procurement team needs list pricing in EUR for both the platform fee and operator/site licenses. 2) We run across 8 distinct SKU lines in your standard matrix (operator seats, site license, per‑GPU node credits, observability add‑on, SRE retainer, etc.). Procurement asked if you can propose a consolidated SKU approach to simplify invoicing (preferably: platform fee + node credits + single support tier).

Also, engineering asked whether you can amortize the platform fee across a three‑phase rollout (pilot -> regional pilot -> prod), and whether you offer phased support tranches (e.g., basic during pilot, standard for regional pilot, premium for prod) with downgrade/upgrade windows.

Can you share a sample EUR quote and a recommended SKU consolidation that keeps us audit‑friendly? We will share expected node counts once finance confirms internal approvals.

Best,
Sofia Rossi
VP, Cloud Platforms
CloudHealth Systems

--
Attachment: internal procurement template (referenced, not attached)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Rossi <sofia.rossi@cloudhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing inquiry — EUR quoting and SKU consolidation

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear asks and for looping procurement. Really appreciate the specificity — makes it straightforward to map to a commercial construct. High level answers below; I'll follow up with a short consolidated XLS and a sample EUR quote by EOD.

1) Localized EUR quoting: we can provide a EUR denominated quote. Two notes: list prices will be expressed in EUR but the legal invoice currency can be USD or EUR depending on the SOW. We'll highlight exchange rate assumptions and a 90‑day reprice clause.

2) SKU consolidation option: we can offer a simplified bundle that combines: platform fee (annual) + node credits (prepaid GPU node credits) + single support tier (three tiers available). Optional observability add‑on can be listed as a line item. I'll attach a proposed SKU matrix with the consolidated view and an example amortization schedule for the platform fee across three phases.

3) Phased support tranches & amortization: we support timebound support tier changes at milestone handoffs (pilot -> regional -> prod). For billing, we can amortize the platform fee across the phases with a simple pro‑rata schedule or a milestone‑based invoicing approach — both are common. We can also include a modest pilot credit (one month of platform fee) conditioned on a committed conversion window.

I'm attaching the SKU matrix and a first‑pass SOW template for your procurement/legal team to review. If you can send expected node ranges and preferred currency for invoicing, we'll produce a narrow EUR quote (list and potential committed discount bands) by EOD.

Thanks — talk soon.
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Redwood_Privdeploy_SKU_matrix_v1.xlsx; Master_SOW_draft.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment pricing inquiry — internal notes and pricing approach

Priyom / David / Hannah — forwarding Sofia's message and Priyom's draft. Quick internal notes:

- Consolidated SKU suggestion: platform_fee_annual (EUR) + node_credit_packs (50/200/500 GPU credits) + support_tier (pilot/basic, standard, premium). Keep observability as opt‑in. This simplifies procurement and reduces invoice lines.
- Discounting: propose a commitment tier structure tied to prepaid node credits over 12/24 months. Example: 10% off list at 200+ node credits, 18% at 500+. Avoid deeply discounting platform fee — instead offer pilot credit (one month) and onboarding credit.
- EUR quoting: operations note — include a FX clause and an explicit invoice currency field in the SOW (client may prefer EUR to avoid translation risk).
- Legal redlines: David — can you run the master SOW for the amortization language and milestone billing? Hannah — can you confirm support tier definitions and our uplift pricing for premium on‑call?

I'll draft two commercial options for Sofia: (A) Clean consolidated bundle with 12‑month prepaid node credits and tiered discounting; (B) Lower commitment option with monthly consumption + higher platform fee amortized.

Marissa
Senior Director, Commercial

--
(Quoted text from Priyom Das)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Jul 2025 15:23:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment pricing inquiry — internal notes and pricing approach

Marissa — quick legal/commercial guidance:

1) Amortization & FX: we can add language to the SOW that defines the platform fee amortization schedule and specifies invoice currency. Recommend a 90‑day FX review clause and a surface clause that commits Redwood to list EUR pricing but reserves final invoice currency.
2) Pilot credits & conversion window: pilot credit is fine (one month platform fee) conditioned on conversion to a paid bundle within 120 days. Make sure the conversion is tied to a minimum node commitment (e.g., 50 node credits) to avoid churn risk.
3) Support tranches: define upgrade/downgrade windows and an explicit chargeback for mid‑period downgrades. Penalty for early termination should be a simple pro rata for prepaid node credits plus a fixed termination fee for SOW exit.

I'll send a redline of the SOW (amortization and billing clauses) by EOD tomorrow.

David
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Rossi <sofia.rossi@cloudhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@cloudhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing inquiry — localized EUR quote and two commercial options

Hi Sofia / procurement team —

Appended below are two concise commercial options and a note on the EUR quote. Attached in Drive is the consolidated SKU matrix and a clean SOW redline (David's sections included).

Option A — Consolidated prepaid bundle (recommended)
- Currency: EUR list pricing; invoiced in EUR
- Term: 12 months prepaid node credits; platform fee (annual) amortized across milestones
- Pricing anchor: platform_fee = €95,000/year; node_credit_packs = €X per 50/200/500 pack (see XLS)
- Discounting: 12% off node credits at 200+ prepaid; 20% at 500+ prepaid
- Support: Standard included (8x5 SLAs); Premium add‑on available as uplift (on‑call + 1hr P1 response)
- Pilot: one month platform_fee credit conditioned on conversion within 120 days and minimum 50 node credit purchase

Option B — Low‑commitment, higher flexibility
- Currency: EUR list pricing; invoiced monthly in EUR or USD (client choice)
- Term: month‑to‑month node drawdown; higher platform effective rate (platform_fee = €120k annualized)
- Discounting: minimal (5%) for month‑to‑month precommit credits
- Support: Pilot/basic by default; upgrades allowed at next billing cycle

EUR quote note: attached XLS contains line‑by‑line EUR list prices and an example invoice schedule. We include an FX clause and will honor list EUR pricing for 90 days.

Next steps: if procurement prefers Option A, can you confirm an expected initial node‑credit band (50 / 200 / 500) and preferred billing currency? Once we have that, we'll issue a formal quote and route the SOW to legal for signature.

Thanks again — happy to hop on a 30m call if you prefer to walk through the SKU matrix.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
